source_prompt: the memory game should be fully playable

checks.statement: Before clicking Start, all cards are face down and no score is shown.
Clicking Start begins the game and makes the board interactive.
Clicking a face-down card flips it face up.
A matching pair of cards stays face up after being matched.
A non-matching pair flips back face down within roughly 1.5s.
The score increases by exactly one point per matched pair, not per click.
Rapidly double-clicking the same card does not count it as its own match or duplicate the flip animation.
Once all pairs are matched, a clear game-over or win state appears.
Restart resets the board, the score, and any in-progress card selection.
Reloading the page mid-game does not leave the UI in a broken or half-rendered state.
